note: Made by the steps in TV_PICTURES.md: the chapter is split into sections that each carry one deep meaning ("sections"), 10 picture ideas are written for each, the top two for each picture are made and the better is chosen by eye (2026-11-22). Wide pictures only (1920x1088); the "tall" names are kept for the day tall pictures are switched back on. Each scene starts at the first word of its verse. The important part of every picture sits in the upper two thirds, clear of the words. God is not pictured; Jesus, John and Nicodemus are not portrayed as biblical people, and ordinary people of today stand in for what the verses teach.
method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21 after the sentence-by-sentence pictures did not connect: (1) split the chapter into sections that each carry one deep meaning, written as one plain sentence; (2) write 10 different picture ideas for each section; (3) judge them: which shows the deep meaning most truly, then which a watcher understands at once while hearing the words, then which is most engaging; (4) make the top two for each picture slot as real pictures ("candidates") and choose by eye. A section has one or two pictures.

sections.meaning: To see God's kingdom a person needs a whole new birth from above, something even a respected teacher who comes seeking at night cannot make happen by himself.
ideas: A grey-haired man in a good coat walks alone down a dark street at night toward the one lit doorway
A grey-haired man climbs an outside staircase at night toward a lit doorway at the top
A respected older man sits in his parked car at night outside a house with one lit window, hesitating
An old man stands at a hospital nursery window gazing in wonder at a row of newborn babies
A grey-haired man holds his newborn grandson and stares at him, amazed that life can start new
A butterfly breaks out of its chrysalis on a twig in light falling from above
A new green shoot springs from an old cut stump
Rain falls from above on a dry cracked field and tiny green shoots spring up
An old man studies his wrinkled face in the bathroom mirror, puzzled
A seed splits open in dark soil as light shines down on it

sections.meaning: That new birth comes from the spirit: unseen like the wind, but real, and known by what it does.
ideas: A small sailboat runs fast across a bright bay, its sail full of a wind no one can see
A man stands on a grassy hilltop with his eyes closed, listening, as the wind bends the whole hill of grass
A kite climbs high on the wind while a boy holds the string
Washing on a line billows in a strong wind on a hilltop
Autumn leaves whirl up off a path in a sudden gust
Dandelion seeds are carried off into the air
A wheat field ripples in long waves under the wind
A wind chime swings on a porch with no one near it
A tall row of poplars bends all one way in the wind
A hawk hangs still on the wind above a cliff, its wings spread

sections.meaning: Only the one who came down from heaven can tell heavenly things, and he must be lifted up so that everyone who trusts him may have eternal life.
ideas: A grey-haired scholar sits late at night at a desk piled with open books, his head in his hands, baffled
An old teacher stands at his study window at night, a book forgotten in his hand, staring up at the stars
A grandfather squints, baffled, at a phone his grandson holds out to him
A man back from far away describes what he saw while his listeners shake their heads
A stranded climber on a cliff ledge reaches up as a rescuer is lowered to him on a line from a helicopter above
A man at the bottom of a deep well looks up at the bright opening as a rope comes down to him
Lost hikers in a dark valley look up at a bright flare high in the sky and turn toward it
Swimmers in a rough sea turn toward a lantern held high at the bow of a lifeboat
A crowd in a snowy night looks up to a beacon on a tall mast above the town
A man sinking in floodwater grabs a lifebuoy thrown down from a bridge

sections.meaning: God loved the world so much that he gave his only Son, not to condemn the world but to save it.
ideas: A father, seen from behind, stands at a tall window at dawn holding up his newborn son before a vast city waking below
A father, seen from behind, lifts his small son high in both arms on a hilltop above a wide city
The whole earth seen from space as sunlight spreads over it
A father lets go of his only son's hand on a station platform as the son leaves for a disaster zone
An old father holds his grown son's face in both hands before the son goes out into the storm
A judge steps down from his bench to help up a man who has fallen
A hand reaches down from a boat to a man in the sea
Rescue ship lights cut through a storm toward a sinking boat
A father carries his son on his shoulders through a cheering crowd
A father's hands cradle a newborn while light from a window falls on them

sections.meaning: The light has come; people who do wrong hide from it, and people who do the truth come gladly into it.
ideas: A man pulls the curtains shut against a bright morning and sits back in the dark lit only by a screen
A man hurriedly shoves an envelope into a drawer as the door opens and light falls across his desk
A torch beam sweeps a dark warehouse and a man ducks behind the boxes
A man in a dark alley shields his face from a car's headlights
A sunbeam falls across a room and a man moves his chair back into the shadow
A carpenter carries his finished chair out of his dim workshop into bright sunshine to look at it
A glassmaker holds a clear new vase up to a sunny window, flawless and nothing hidden
A woman throws open the shutters of her bakery so the street can see her work
A boy brings his schoolwork to his father at a sunny kitchen table
A potter lifts a finished bowl into the window light and turns it slowly

sections.meaning: John's followers are troubled that everyone is now going to the other one.
ideas: At a market, a long line forms at a new stall while two young helpers at the older stall beside it watch, worried
Two young men tug at an older craftsman's sleeve and point across the street at a crowd at another workshop
A crowd streams past a small cafe toward a new one across the square while the cafe's staff stare after them
A busker's audience drifts down the street toward another musician while his friends glare
Everyone crowds round a newly landed fishing boat while the old fisherman's sons frown
Many people walk along a river path, all heading the same way toward a bend in the river
An old ferry waits empty at its jetty while people cross a new bridge
Two lemonade stands side by side, children crowding one
Two young apprentices peer through a workshop window at a long queue across the road
A teacher's students glance over their shoulders at a bigger crowd gathering nearby

sections.meaning: John is glad, like the bridegroom's friend at a wedding: the other must grow and he must become less.
ideas: At an outdoor wedding the best man stands a step back, beaming, as the groom (seen from behind) takes the bride's hands
The best man listens to the groom's vows with happy tears and a huge smile
The best man hands the groom the ring, smiling
The best man steps out of the photograph so the couple are pictured alone
The best man straightens the groom's tie before the ceremony
As the sun rises over the hills, the last bright morning star fades in the brightening sky
A man on a hillside turns down the lantern he carried through the night as sunrise floods the valley
A night watchman switches off a street lamp as the sun comes up
An old coach steps back off the pitch as the young player he trained takes the ball
The moon pales in the sky as the sun climbs

sections.meaning: The one from above speaks God's own words; the Father loves the Son and has given everything into his hand, and trusting him is life.
ideas: An old father's hand presses the keys of the family farm into his grown son's open hand
A father and grown son, seen from behind at a gate, the father's arm round him and his other hand sweeping out over all the land
An old craftsman hands his son his own worn tools at the workbench
A captain steps back and puts the ship's wheel into his son's hands
A father puts the reins of his horses into his son's hands
A jug of water poured into a glass that overflows and keeps on running
A view from a mountaintop above the clouds
Rain pours without measure over thirsty fields
A father stands proudly behind his son at the wheel of the family boat
An old man slips the family ring onto his son's finger

candidates.principle: Nicodemus, a ruler and teacher, comes to him at night.
candidates.shows: A grey-haired man in a dark coat walks alone down a quiet night street toward the one lit doorway.
candidates.prompt: Late on a calm, peaceful evening, a respected grey-haired gentleman in a long dark wool coat walks up the front path of a small friendly house toward its open front door, which glows with warm yellow lamplight where he is expected. The rest of the quiet street lies in soft deep-blue evening shade under a few street lamps. He is seen from a little behind and to the side. The man and the glowing doorway are in the upper part of the picture.

candidates.principle: Nicodemus, a ruler and teacher, comes to him at night.
candidates.shows: Late at night a grey-haired man in a dark coat climbs an outside stair toward a lit doorway at the top.
candidates.prompt: Late on a calm, peaceful evening in a quiet modern town, a respected grey-haired gentleman in a long dark wool coat walks up a short flight of outdoor steps toward a welcoming open doorway glowing with warm lamplight at the top. Everything else lies in soft deep-blue evening shade. He is seen from below and behind, one hand on the rail. The glowing doorway and the man are in the upper part of the picture.

candidates.principle: Unless someone is born from above he cannot see the kingdom of God. How can a man be born when he is old?
candidates.shows: An old man stands at a hospital nursery window, gazing in wonder at a row of newborn babies.
candidates.prompt: In a quiet hospital corridor, a grey-haired old man in a cardigan stands at the big glass window of a maternity nursery, one hand resting on the glass, gazing in puzzled wonder at a row of newborn babies asleep in clear cots on the other side. His face is seen in three-quarter view. Soft clean daylight. The man's face and the babies are in the upper part of the picture.

candidates.principle: Unless someone is born from above he cannot see the kingdom of God.
candidates.shows: A butterfly has just come out of its chrysalis, its fresh wings unfolding in light from above.
candidates.prompt: A close view of a butterfly that has just come out of its chrysalis, clinging to the empty split shell on a twig, its fresh new wings unfolding, bright and clean, in soft light falling from above. A green garden is softly blurred behind. The butterfly is in the upper part of the picture.

candidates.principle: Born from the spirit: the wind blows where it wants; you hear it but do not know where it comes from or goes.
candidates.shows: A small sailboat runs fast across a bright bay, its sail full of an unseen wind.
candidates.prompt: A small white sailboat heels over and runs fast across a wide bright blue bay, its sail filled full and taut by a strong wind. Ripples and whitecaps race across the water in the same direction, spray flies at the bow, and one sailor leans out at the helm. Clear midday light, white clouds driven across the sky. The boat and its sail are in the upper part of the picture.

candidates.principle: Born from the spirit: the wind blows where it wants; you hear it but do not know where it comes from or goes.
candidates.shows: A man stands eyes closed on a grassy hilltop, listening, as the wind bends the whole hill of grass round him.
candidates.prompt: On top of a wide grassy hill, a man in his forties stands with his eyes closed and his face lifted, listening, as a strong wind sweeps over the hill, bending the long grass all round him in silver waves and tugging at his jacket and hair. Clouds race across a bright sky in clear afternoon light. The man is in the upper part of the picture.

candidates.principle: How can these things be? You are the teacher of Israel, and you do not know these things?
candidates.shows: Late at night a grey-haired scholar sits at a desk piled with open books, his head in his hands, baffled.
candidates.prompt: Late at night in a book-lined study, a grey-haired scholar in a cardigan sits at a wooden desk piled high with open books under a single lamp, his head in his hands, completely baffled. A dark window is behind him. His face, his hands and the lamp are in the upper part of the picture.

candidates.principle: If you do not believe earthly things, how will you believe heavenly things?
candidates.shows: An old teacher stands at his study window at night, a book forgotten in his hand, staring up at the stars, puzzled.
candidates.prompt: Late at night an old teacher with grey hair stands at the open window of his study, a closed book hanging forgotten in one hand, staring up at a sky full of stars, his face puzzled and searching. Lamp-lit shelves of books glow behind him. His face and the starry sky are in the upper part of the picture.

candidates.principle: No one has gone up into heaven except the one who came down from heaven; he must be lifted up, so that everyone who believes may have eternal life.
candidates.shows: A climber on a mountain ledge raises his arms as a rescuer is lowered to him on a line from a helicopter above.
candidates.prompt: A mountain rescue on a bright clear day: high on a rocky mountainside, a climber standing on a wide rock ledge raises both arms gladly toward a rescuer in a red suit who is being lowered toward him on a cable from a helicopter hovering above in the blue sky, the rescuer reaching down to him. A green valley lies far below. The climber, the rescuer and the helicopter are all in the upper part of the picture.

candidates.principle: No one has gone up into heaven except the one who came down from heaven; he must be lifted up, so that everyone who believes may have eternal life.
candidates.shows: At the bottom of a deep well a man looks up at the bright opening as a rope comes down to him.
candidates.prompt: Looking up from inside a deep, dry, round stone well on a sunny day: a man stands at the bottom with his face turned up toward the bright circle of daylight far above, smiling, as a rope is let down toward him from the opening and comes within reach of his raised hand. Sunlight falls from the opening onto his upturned face. The bright opening, the rope and his face are in the upper part of the picture.

candidates.principle: God loved the world in this way, that he gave the only Son, so that everyone who believes in him might not perish but have eternal life.
candidates.shows: Seen from behind, a father at a tall window at dawn holds up his newborn son before a vast city waking below.
candidates.prompt: Seen from behind, a father stands at a tall window at dawn, holding his newborn son, wrapped in a white blanket, safely up in both arms before the glass, as if showing him to the world. Far below, a vast city is waking, the first light spreading over its streets and rooftops. The room is dim and the city glows. The father, the baby and the city are in the upper part of the picture.

candidates.principle: God loved the world in this way, that he gave the only Son, so that everyone who believes in him might not perish but have eternal life.
candidates.shows: Seen from behind, a father on a hilltop lifts his small son high in both arms above a wide city.
candidates.prompt: On a grassy hilltop in clear bright morning light, seen from behind, a father lifts his small son high above his head in both arms, both of them facing a wide city spread out far below in the sunshine. The father and the lifted boy are in the upper part of the picture, against the open sky.

candidates.principle: The light has come into the world, and people loved the darkness rather than the light.
candidates.shows: A man pulls the curtains shut against a bright morning and turns back to a dark room lit only by a screen.
candidates.prompt: Bright sunshine outside, but inside a cramped untidy room a young man is pulling the heavy curtains shut against the sunlight, turning back toward the dark room lit only by the cold blue glow of a screen. A thin blade of sunlight still cuts between the curtains. The man and the closing curtains are in the upper part of the picture.

candidates.principle: Everyone who practices worthless things hates the light, so that his works may not be exposed.
candidates.shows: In a dim office a man shoves an envelope into a drawer as the door opens and bright light falls across his desk.
candidates.prompt: In a dim office, a man in a shirt and loosened tie hurriedly shoves a fat brown envelope into a desk drawer as the door behind him swings open and a wide bar of bright light falls across the desk and his startled face. The man, his hands and the light are in the upper part of the picture.

candidates.principle: The one who does the truth comes to the light, so that his works may be revealed.
candidates.shows: A carpenter carries his finished chair out of his dim workshop into bright sunshine to look at it in full light.
candidates.prompt: A carpenter in a work apron steps out through the wide open doors of his dim workshop into bright sunshine, holding up a finished wooden chair to see it in the full light, every joint and the grain of the wood plain to see, his face open and glad. Clear midday light. The carpenter and the chair are in the upper part of the picture.

candidates.principle: The one who does the truth comes to the light, so that his works may be revealed.
candidates.shows: A glassmaker holds a clear new vase up to a sunny window, light passing straight through it.
candidates.prompt: In a glass workshop, a craftswoman holds a clear, newly made glass vase up to a bright sunny window, the sunlight passing straight through it and showing it flawless, nothing hidden, light sparkling on her face and hands. The vase and her face are in the upper part of the picture.

candidates.principle: Rabbi, the one who was with you is baptizing, and everyone is coming to him.
candidates.shows: At a market a long line forms at a new stall while two young helpers at the older stall beside it watch, worried.
candidates.prompt: At a small outdoor market in a town square on a fresh morning, a long line of people has formed at a new stall, and more people are walking toward it. At the older stall right beside it, which has no customers, two young helpers in aprons lean together and watch the crowd with worried faces. The helpers and the line of people are in the upper part of the picture.

candidates.principle: Rabbi, the one who was with you is baptizing, and everyone is coming to him.
candidates.shows: Two young apprentices tug at an older craftsman's sleeve and point across the street at a crowd at another door.
candidates.prompt: On a town street on a fresh morning, two young apprentices in work aprons tug at the sleeve of an older craftsman standing calm in the doorway of his workshop, both pointing across the street, where a big crowd of people is gathering round the door of another workshop. The three men and the far crowd are in the upper part of the picture.

candidates.principle: The friend of the bridegroom stands and hears him and rejoices with joy at the bridegroom's voice.
candidates.shows: At an outdoor wedding the best man stands a step back, beaming, as the groom, seen from behind, takes the bride's hands.
candidates.prompt: At an outdoor wedding in a garden in soft afternoon light, the best man stands a step back from the couple, beaming with joy, his hands clasped. In front of him the groom, seen from behind, takes the bride's hands. The best man's glad face is the centre of the picture, in its upper part.

candidates.principle: The friend of the bridegroom stands and hears him and rejoices with joy at the bridegroom's voice.
candidates.shows: The best man, just behind the groom's shoulder, listens to the vows with shining eyes and a huge smile.
candidates.prompt: At an outdoor wedding, a close view of the best man standing just behind the groom's shoulder, listening to the groom speak his vows, his eyes shining with happy tears and a huge smile on his face. The groom is only a blurred shoulder and the back of his head in the foreground. Soft afternoon light. The best man's face is in the upper part of the picture.

candidates.principle: That one must grow, but I must become less. The one who comes from above is above all.
candidates.shows: As the sun rises over the hills, the last bright morning star fades in the brightening sky.
candidates.prompt: Dawn over a wide valley of hills: the sun is rising over the far ridge, flooding the sky with growing golden light, and high above, the last bright morning star is fading into the brightening blue. Mist lies in the valley. The sun and the star are in the upper part of the picture.

candidates.principle: That one must grow, but I must become less. The one who comes from above is above all.
candidates.shows: On a hillside at sunrise a man turns down the lantern he carried through the night as the sun floods the valley.
candidates.prompt: On a hillside at sunrise, a man in a coat lowers the small lantern he has carried through the night and turns down its little flame, smiling, as the rising sun floods the whole valley below with light. The man, the lantern and the sunrise are in the upper part of the picture.

candidates.principle: The Father loves the Son and has given all things into his hand.
candidates.shows: An old father's hand presses the keys of the family farm into his grown son's open hand.
candidates.prompt: A close view of an old father's weathered hand pressing a heavy ring of old keys into his grown son's open, cupped hand. Behind them, softly blurred, the wide fields and barns of the family farm in bright clear afternoon light. The two hands and the keys are in the upper part of the picture.

candidates.principle: The Father loves the Son and has given all things into his hand.
candidates.shows: Seen from behind at a gate, an old father puts his arm round his grown son and sweeps his other hand out over all the land.
candidates.prompt: Seen from behind, an old father and his grown son stand at a wooden farm gate looking out over wide green farmland that stretches away to the hills, the father's arm round his son's shoulders and his other hand sweeping out over all of it. Bright clear afternoon with high white clouds. The two men and the land are in the upper part of the picture.
